title: Kempty Falls Mussoorie, Uttarkhant | Complete Travel Guide
content:
Kempty Falls - Mussoorie,

Kempty Falls is one of the most popular waterfalls in Uttarakhand, located about 15 km from Mussoorie on the road to Yamunotri. Surrounded by mountains and forests, the waterfall drops from a height of 40 feet, creating a natural pool where visitors can splash and relax.

The name "Kempty" comes from the phrase “camp-tea”, as the British used to host tea parties near the falls during the colonial era. Today, it is one of the busiest picnic spots in the Mussoorie region, attracting families, honeymooners, and nature lovers.

Visitors can enjoy bathing in the cold water, boating in nearby ponds, shopping at local stalls, and taking photographs of the scenic views. Kempty Falls is also a stopover for people traveling to Yamunotri and Chakrata.

Best Time to Visit Kempty Falls:

  • Peak Season (March – June): Weather is pleasant, 15°C – 25°C. Best for bathing and picnics.
  • Moderate Season (September – November): Cool weather, 10°C – 20°C. Water is fresh and clear, great for sightseeing.
  • Low Season (December – February):Cold, 2°C – 10°C. Water is freezing, not ideal for bathing but good for photography.
  • Monsoon (July – August):15°C – 22°C. The waterfall is full and powerful, but heavy rains make roads slippery. Travel with caution.

Things to Do at Kempty Falls:

  • Enjoy Bathing: Splash around in the natural pool formed by the waterfall.
  • Photography: Capture the beauty of the waterfall and green surroundings.
  • Boating: Small boats are available near the lower falls.
  • Cable Car Ride: A ropeway takes you closer to the falls.
  • Shopping: Buy woolens, toys, snacks, and souvenirs at local stalls.
  • Picnic: Spend time with family near the pool and enjoy snacks.
  • Nature Walks: Explore small trails around the falls.

How to Reach Kempty Falls:

  • By Road: Located 15 km from Mussoorie and about 45 km from Dehradun. Easily reachable by taxi, cab, 
  • By Train: Nearest railway station is Dehradun (45 km).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant Airport (69 km).

Best Places to Visit Near Kempty Falls (within 50 km):

1- Mussoorie Mall Road (15 km): Shopping, food, and colonial charm.

2- Gun Hill Point (16 km): Ropeway ride with panoramic views.

3- Camel’s Back Road (16 km): Peaceful walking route.

4- Company Garden (14 km): Colorful flowers and boating.

5- Lal Tibba (20 km): Highest point of Mussoorie.

6- George Everest’s House (18 km): Historic house with great views.

7- Bhatta Falls (22 km): Less crowded natural waterfall.

8- Dhanaulti (40 km): Eco parks and camping.

9- Jharipani Falls (22 km): Quiet and scenic waterfall.

10- Cloud’s End (19 km): Trekking trails and forest views.

Timings & Entry Fee: Opening Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Entry Fee: Free, Ropeway Charges: Around ₹80–100 per person (one way)
